mentions.name: ikanban
mentions.description: A PWA Kanban board that stores data in the browser and is built entirely with vanilla code and no external dependencies, making it usable in workplaces that restrict unapproved IT systems when handling customer data.
mentions.problem: The author works somewhere that doesn't use JIRA or Trello and can't adopt non-approved IT systems due to customer data restrictions, leaving them without a Kanban tool.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I vibed a PWA Kanban system. Stores data in browser and only vanilla code. No external dependencies.

https://github.com/efriese/ikanban
